headline: Blazehowl fire mount
title: Blazehowl | Fire Lion Mount For Kindling | Palworld Guide
video_script: Need a fiery ground mount in Palworld one point zero? Blazehowl is a Fire Pal with Kindling level five and Lumbering level three. Its partner skill, Hellflame Lion, lets you ride it, and Grass Pals in your party drop forty to eighty percent more items when defeated. The bonus does not stack. Will you tame a Blazehowl? Comment below!
description: Blazehowl in Palworld 1.0 is a rideable Fire Pal with Kindling level five and a Grass drop bonus.
